chapter two · day 4 of 5

closer than ever

the year we became inseparable
✦
Vasavi fest — our very first picture together
still the most memorable photo I own

Dear Nanna,

Four days left until your birthday, and today I want to talk about the year "just friends" quietly turned into something I couldn't imagine losing.

It started right after that Chemistry lab day. We exchanged numbers, and normal conversations began — studies, likes, dislikes, everything. First year, I took the 25 bus, so it was mostly texting and the odd call. Second year, I switched to the 24 bus — your bus — and started sitting right in front of your seat. That's when everything changed. Fights over silly things, shared snacks, funny games on the ride — that's when you truly became close to me.

That same year, our friends went to Vasavi fest. That day, I spent real time with you for the first time, and we took this photo — still the most memorable one I have.

Then summer came, and you left for your internship in Vijayawada. We talked constantly — sharing reels, teasing each other, becoming best friends by sharing every problem, every family issue, cheering each other on. When you came back, you brought me a pair of earrings — the first gift I ever received from you.

Third year came. I buried myself in studies, you threw yourself into every college activity. That's when our IEEE event happened — I was a participant, you were an organizer. After it ended, we took our second picture, my hand in yours. It's one of the closest I've ever felt to you.

And in that same quiet moment, you left a small kiss on my forehead — with my permission, as a close friend. 🌱

IEEE event — holding your hand for the first time
